# BTicino C300X Native Agent Integration v0.5.1

Hotfix release for Home Assistant 2026.6 runtime behavior.

## Highlights

- Fixes Home Assistant thread-safety warnings caused by doorbell video TTL
  callbacks updating dispatcher/entity state from the wrong execution context.
- Buffers early WebRTC ICE candidates until the peer connection has a remote
  description, avoiding noisy `addIceCandidate called without remote
  description` warnings during camera startup.

## Notes

- The native C300X device agent is unchanged from `0.5.0`; this release only
  updates the Home Assistant integration package.
- If Home Assistant shows other C300X Repairs during an update, handle the
  device-agent update Repair first when it exists, then reload the integration
  before acting on temporary follow-up Repairs.
